# Suite page for multi-repo suites

## What to build

The suite web page (`suite/server.ts` + `web/assets/suitepage.js`) shows a multi-repo suite (`suite.json` has `project` and `repos`) correctly (spec goals **MR-04**, **MR-05**, section "Engine: the suite page"):
- each feature box is titled with its **repo name**; there are **no merge or integration-agent nodes**; a repo without a feature is drawn as a small box marked **`unchanged`**;
- the joint phase's first node (today `@e2e-validate`) is titled **`Joint review`**, its card says how many repos passed validation, and its panel lists **each repo's validation result** (from `suite.json` `joint.validation`);
- the phase bar reads `features → joint → (human) → apply`, the apply node and the summary report per repo;
- diffs of the joint fixer node, the apply node and the human review use **prefixed paths** (`api/src/x.ts`) served from the right repo, and the **file tree groups the files by repo**;
- the **human review** (`--human-review`) works on the combined diff: `/api/review*` and `/api/file?round=` read each repo, comments carry the prefixed path and are anchored against that repo's diff.
Single-repo suites and run pages must look and behave exactly as today.

NOT in this task: the engine's joint phase (done), `list`/`clean`/`open`, graph-manager.

## What already exists (delivered by earlier tasks; read these first)

- `suite/state.ts`: `project?: { dir, name, contract }`; per feature `repo?: { name, path, startingCommit, startBranch? }`; `repos?: { name, path, startingCommit, startBranch?, applied?: { files: number, conflicts: string[] } }[]` (every repo, project order); `joint?: { base: Record<name, sha> /* each repo's suite/<rid> head when the joint phase started */, validation: { repo, ok, commands, command?, exitCode?, at }[] }`. `features` may have a single entry. A project suite has no top-level `startBranch` (per repo instead) and no `integration.merged` entries. Its `review` field holds the joint phase's progress (same `ReviewState` as the e2e phase).
- `review/workspace.ts`: `formatHeads(record)`, `parseHeads(text): Record<string,string> | undefined` (joint heads look like `api=<sha> web=<sha>`), `prefixPath(name, file)`, `splitPrefixed(file, names): { name, path } | undefined`.
- `suite/joint.ts`: `interface JointRange { name; repo; from; to }`, `jointRangeChanges(ranges): Promise<ChangedFile[]>` (`ChangedFile` from `runner/events.ts`; `FileDiff`/`FileLines` from `runner/changes.ts`) (each repo's `rangeChanges`, paths prefixed, sorted), `jointDirOf`, `jointRepoDir`.
- The human review round file of a multi-repo suite (`<suiteDir>/human/round<N>.json`, `loadHumanRound`) has `diffBase` / `diffHead` as **joint heads** (`parseHeads` gives one sha per repo).
- The reviewers task gave the e2e reviewer nodes the ids `@e2e-reviewer`, `@e2e-tester` (built-ins) and `@e2e-<id>` (custom reviewers), drawn from the suite's reviewers; keep that code and only retitle/rewire around it. The e2e nodes are `@e2e-validate`, the reviewer nodes, `@e2e-fixer`, `@human`, `@apply`.
- `serveSuite` passes `review.repo = repoRoot(cwd)`, which is the **project folder** for a multi-repo suite; repo paths come from `suite.repos[].path`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `docs/prd/multi-repo.md` — "Engine: the suite page (MR-04, MR-05)".
- `packages/graph-execution/src/suite/server.ts` (whole file, ~500 lines): `FeatureView` (46–62), `featureView` (253–272), `reviewRoute` (154–223: `/api/review`, `/api/review/diff`, `/api/review/files`, comments with `checkAnchor(human.repo, …)`), `/api/suite` (386–398), `/api/file` (400–429), `/api/changes` (430–444).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/suite/changes.ts` (whole file): `ChangeSource` (`range` / `live`), `suiteChangeSources` (uses one `repo` for every feature, lines 267–321), `changesOf` / `allChangesOf` (325–347, cache by resolved commit pair).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/web/server.ts` (lines 53–62) `finalFileDiff(repo, from, to, file)` → `{ path, diff, truncated, binary }`, `finalFileLines`; `runner/changes.ts` `gitFileLines`, `worktreeFileDiff`; `review/anchor.ts` (whole, 31 lines) `checkAnchor(repo, from, to, input)`.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/web/assets/suitepage.js` (607 lines): `PHASES` (8), `loopNodes` (59–80), `buildModel` (135–183), `layout` (185–220), `renderGraph` (233–277: clusters `rect`/`.ctitle`/`.cmeta`), `currentPhase`/`renderHeader` (281–308), `renderSummary` (315–345), `infoOf` (420–456), `renderPanel` (457–528: `mountDiffView(list, { files, loadDiff, loadLines })`), `updateReview` (534–553).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/web/assets/diffview.js` (lines 190–260 options and mount, 455–495 `renderTree`: one `.dv-trow` per file, flat list) and `diffview.css` (lines 11–22 tree styles).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/web/assets/review.js` (lines 80–100 `mountReview` options, 336–372: its own `mountDiffView` and the `.dv-trow` comment counts).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/web/assets/graph.css` (lines 72–77 cluster styles), `web/assets/theme.css` (tokens).
- Tests to copy from: `suite/server.test.ts` (lines 1–60 `setup()` writing a `suite.json` and feature `state.json`, `tempRepo`/`gitOut`, `startHumanRound`; the human-review route tests further down), `web/assets/diffview.test.ts` (pure function tests of a browser module).

## Patterns to follow

Server route guard: only paths from the node's own change list reach git (`server.ts:437-438`):
```ts
if (!(await changesOf(source))?.files.some((c) => c.path === file)) return void json(res, 400, { error: "unknown file" });
```
Range source of a finished node (`changes.ts:318`): `sources.set("@apply", { kind: "range", repo, from: suite.startingCommit, to: head })`.
Cluster drawing (`suitepage.js:241-247`): `svgEl("g", { class: "cluster clickable" … })` + `rect` + `.mark` + `.ctitle` + `.cmeta`.
Colors only from CSS tokens (`v("--muted")`, `COLOR` map); no hard-coded colors.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/suite/changes.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - Add `| { kind: "joint"; parts: JointRange[] }` to `ChangeSource` (doc: "several repos; file paths are prefixed `<name>/`").
  - In `suiteChangeSources`, use the feature's own repo for its task and fixer ranges: `const repoOf = (f) => f.repo?.path ?? repo` (a multi-repo feature's commits live in its repo). If the previous tasks already did this, keep it.
  - For a multi-repo suite (`suite.repos` set) skip the merge/integration/`@e2e-fixer`/`@apply` single-repo code and add instead, with `branch = suiteBranchOf(suite.suiteId)` and each repo's `head = await resolveRef(r.path, branch)` (skip repos where it is undefined):
    - `@e2e-fixer`: `{ kind: "joint", parts }` for the repos where `suite.joint?.base[r.name]` is set and differs from `head` (`from: base`, `to: head`); only when there is at least one part;
    - `@apply`: when `suite.review?.phase === "done"` or the status is `applied`/`done`: parts for every repo with `from: r.startingCommit, to: head`.
  - `allChangesOf` for `joint`: resolve every part's `from`/`to` with `resolveRef(part.repo, …)` (undefined → skip that part), cache by the joined `name:from..to` list like the range cache, `summarizeChanges(await jointRangeChanges(resolvedParts))`.
  - Export `jointPart(source, file)`: for a `joint` source, `splitPrefixed(file, parts.map(p => p.name))` → `{ part, path }` or undefined.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck`

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/suite/server.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `FeatureView` gains `repo?: string` (the feature's `repo.name`), set in `featureView`.
  - `/api/changes` and `/api/file?node=` for a `joint` source: after the existing "file is in the node's list" check, find the part with `jointPart`, then `{ ...(await finalFileDiff(part.repo, part.from, part.to, path)), path: file }` and `gitFileLines(part.repo, part.to, path, from, to)`.
  - Human review over several repos: introduce a small adapter chosen per request from `suite.json` (read with `readSuite()`):
    ```ts
    interface ReviewDiff {
      files(base: string, head: string): Promise<ChangedFile[]>;
      fileDiff(base: string, head: string, file: string): Promise<FileDiff>;
      fileLines(head: string, file: string, from: number, to: number): Promise<FileLines>;
      anchor(base: string, head: string, input: Parameters<typeof checkAnchor>[3]): Promise<string | undefined>;
    }
    ```
    single (no `suite.repos`): today's calls with `human.repo` (`rangeChanges`, `finalFileDiff`, `finalFileLines`, `checkAnchor`). joint: `parseHeads(base)` / `parseHeads(head)` give per-repo shas; `files` = `jointRangeChanges(repos.map(r => ({ name: r.name, repo: r.path, from: base[r.name], to: head[r.name] })))`; `fileDiff`/`fileLines`/`anchor` split the prefixed file with `splitPrefixed`, call the single-repo function on that repo with the unprefixed path, and give back the prefixed `path` (`anchor` passes `{ ...input, file: path }`; an unknown prefix → `"file is not in this round's diff"`). Use it in `/api/review`, `/api/review/diff`, `/api/review/files`, `/api/review/comments` (the anchor check) and the `round=` branch of `/api/file`. Comments keep the prefixed `file` as sent by the page.
- **GOTCHA**: never pass a joint head to git; a `parseHeads` failure on a multi-repo suite is a 500-free `json(res, 400, { error: "unknown round" })`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-execution -- server`

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/web/assets/diffview.js` and `diffview.css`
- **IMPLEMENT**: an optional `group?: (path: string) => string | undefined` in the `ViewOptions` typedef and `mountDiffView`. When set, `renderTree` sorts nothing (files arrive sorted) but inserts a header row `el("dv-tgroup", name)` (not a `.dv-trow`, so review.js's comment counts ignore it) whenever the group changes, and the row's `.dir` part drops the `<group>/` prefix shown in the header (the `data-file` / `title` stay the full prefixed path). Export a pure helper `groupRows(files, group)` returning `[{ group, files }]` in order, and use it in `renderTree`. CSS: `.dv-tgroup { padding: 4px 8px 2px; font: 500 11px var(--font-ui); color: var(--muted); text-transform: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); } .dv-tgroup:first-child { border-top: 0; }`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-execution -- diffview`

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/web/assets/review.js`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `mountReview` options gain `group?: (path: string) => string | undefined`, passed to its `mountDiffView` (line ~358). Keep the `// @ts-check` types valid.

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/web/assets/suitepage.js`
- **IMPLEMENT** (`const multi = (d) => !!(d.suite.repos && d.suite.project)`; `const byRepo = (p) => p.split("/")[0]`):
  - `buildModel`: for multi, box `title` = `f.repo || f.name`; do not add `@merge/*` / `@integration/*`; the joint nodes' parents are each feature's `@fixer/<name>` (`k("fixer")`). For each `suite.repos` entry with no feature (`!d.features.some(f => f.repo === r.name)`) push to `m.unchanged` `{ name: r.name }`. `integrated` (line 173) for multi = every feature `done` and `!!s.review`. Titles: `@e2e-validate` → `"Joint review"` with node text from `joint.validation` (`"2/2 repos passed"`, `"web failed"` when one failed, `"validating"` while the phase is in `validate` and no result yet, else the `loopNodes` text); `@e2e-fixer` → `"joint fixer"`; the reviewer nodes keep the reviewers task's titles; `@apply` → `"apply to every repo"` with text `"applied <n>/<total>"` from `repos[].applied` when `applied`, `"on suite/<rid>"` when `done`.
  - `layout`: after the feature boxes, place each unchanged repo as a box of width `NODE_W + 2 * BOX_PAD`, height `BOX_HEAD + 8`, at the same `y` (`PAD`), advancing `x` by its width + `BOX_GAP`; return them in `boxRects` with `unchanged: true`. With no merge rows, the joint rows start at `bottom + GAP_Y` minus one row (do not leave an empty merge row).
  - `renderGraph`: an unchanged box is drawn like a cluster (class `cluster unchanged`, not clickable) with `.ctitle` = repo name and `.cmeta` = `unchanged`, mark color `colorOf("skipped")`. Add to `graph.css`: `.cluster.unchanged > rect { stroke-dasharray: 4 3; }`.
  - Phases: for multi use `["features", "joint", "human", "done"]`; `currentPhase` returns `"joint"` when `s.review` is set or the status is `integrating`.
  - `infoOf` for `@e2e-validate` in multi: rows `"Each repo's validation commands, in its joint worktree."` then one row per `joint.validation` entry: `"<repo>: passed"`, `"<repo>: no validation commands"` (commands 0), or `"⚠ <repo>: failed: <command> (exit <code>)"`. For `@apply`: one row per repo, `"<name>: <files> files, <conflicts> conflicts"` or `"<name>: not applied"`.
  - `renderSummary` for multi: `applied` → title `Applied as uncommitted changes to every repo`, one line per repo `<name> (<startBranch>): N files changed` plus conflicts; `done` → `Done: the results are on suite/<rid> in every repo`; failed/aborted as today; never read `s.integration.merged` / `s.applied` for multi.
  - Diff views: in `renderPanel` pass `group: multi(d) ? byRepo : undefined` to `mountDiffView` (only nodes whose source is joint have prefixed paths; for feature task nodes pass `undefined`: group only for `@e2e-fixer` and `@apply` keys); in `updateReview` pass `group: multi(data) ? byRepo : undefined` to `mountReview`; the review `context().target` for multi = `"every repo"`, `dropNote` = `"the results stay on suite/<rid> in every repo"`.
- **GOTCHA**: `suitepage.js` runs in the browser with no build step: plain ES modules, relative imports, no new dependencies. Everything must stay unchanged for single-repo suites (no `repos` in `suite.json`).
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint`

### UPDATE tests
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  1. `web/assets/diffview.test.ts` "groupRows groups prefixed paths by repo": `groupRows([{path:"api/a.ts"},{path:"api/b/c.ts"},{path:"web/x.ts"}], (p) => p.split("/")[0])` → `[{ group: "api", files: [2 files] }, { group: "web", files: [1] }]`; without `group` one group with `group: undefined`.
  2. `suite/server.test.ts` "a multi-repo suite: features by repo, joint changes and the human review across repos": two `tempRepo()`s `api`, `web` each with branch `suite/x` one commit ahead (`api/a.txt`, `web/w.txt`), a suite dir with `suite.json` having `project`, `repos` (paths, `startingCommit` = each main sha), one feature `{ name: "api", repo: { name: "api", … } }`, `review: { phase: "done", … }`, status `done`. Assert: `GET /api/suite` → `features[0].repo === "api"`, `changes["@apply"].files` paths `["api/a.txt", "web/w.txt"]`, no `@merge/` keys; `GET /api/changes?node=@apply&file=web/w.txt` → 200 with `path: "web/w.txt"` and a diff containing `+`; `file=web/../x` → 400. Human review: `startHumanRound(suiteDir, 1, formatHeads(starts), formatHeads(heads))`, emit `review:waiting` on the events emitter (pattern of the existing human-review tests in this file) → `GET /api/review` lists both prefixed files; `GET /api/review/diff?file=api/a.txt&round=1` → 200; `POST /api/review/comments { file: "web/w.txt", side: "new", startLine: 1, body: "x" }` → 201 and `{ file: "nope/w.txt", … }` → 400 `file is not in this round's diff`; `GET /api/file?round=1&path=web/w.txt&from=1&to=1` → 200.
  3. Existing `server.test.ts`, `web-e2e.test.ts` and asset tests pass unchanged.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-execution -- server diffview web-e2e`

### Check the page yourself (TESTING.md "Web view" and "Web UI checklist")
- Build (`npm run build -w graph-execution`), make two repos `api`, `web` and a project folder (`git init`, `project.json` naming both, `contract.md`, `specs/api.md`, `tasks/api/1.json` only, committed; give `web` a `graph-execution.config.json` with a passing `validate` command), then in the project folder: `GRAPH_EXECUTION_HANDOFF=detached SSH_CONNECTION=1 node <repo>/packages/graph-execution/dist/cli.js suite --project . --provider fake --web --human-review`. With `agent-browser`: the `api` box is titled `api`, `web` is a dashed `unchanged` box, there is no merge node, the joint node reads `Joint review` and its panel lists `api: no validation commands` and `web: passed`; the Review tab's file tree shows an `api` group header; leave a comment on an `api/…` line and check `<suiteDir>/human/round1.json` has `"file": "api/…"`; press Apply and check the summary names each repo. Also run checklist steps 1, 2, 5 and 10 on this page and on a single-repo suite (`packages/graph-execution/demo/suite/run.sh --human-review`) to confirm nothing changed there. Put the screenshot paths in the task summary.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Multi-repo suite page: feature boxes titled by repo, no merge/integration nodes, dashed `unchanged` boxes for repos without tasks, a `Joint review` node whose panel lists each repo's validation result, phases `features → joint → (human) → apply`.
- [ ] The joint fixer and apply nodes show prefixed diffs, served from the right repo, with the file tree grouped by repo; the human review lists, diffs, anchors and stores comments with prefixed paths across repos.
- [ ] Bad paths (unknown prefix, path not in the node's list) get 400, never reach git.
- [ ] Single-repo suites and run pages are unchanged: all existing tests pass.
- [ ] New tests in `diffview.test.ts` and `server.test.ts` pass on Linux, macOS and Windows; the page was checked in a browser with screenshots.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run build -w graph-execution
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-execution -- server diffview web-e2e suite
```
